LAMB: one learning rate for layers of every size

Scale a layer's weights and watch its LAMB step: it grows with the weight norm, so every layer moves by the same fraction of itself, until the norm passes 10 and the step stops growing.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
